interface.longDescription: Work with GitLab from chat: browse projects and repositories, review and manage merge requests, triage issues, epics and other work items, inspect and run CI/CD pipelines, and manage releases, wiki pages, labels and milestones. Every call runs with the permissions of the GitLab account the server connects with: your own when the server signs you in with GitLab, or the token a local server is started with. The account settings page limits the tools, projects and groups a chat can use or keeps it read-only. Works with GitLab.com and self-managed GitLab 16.0 or later, as the endpoint operator configures. Features GitLab does not offer on an instance or tier stay unavailable there.
